directories.purpose: Hono server entry, middleware, routes, platform bindings, services, repositories, and migrations.
directories.ownership: Server implementation tasks own this subtree unless the plan declares a narrower owner.

directories.purpose: React/Vite browser entry, app composition, pages, components, hooks, browser API client, i18n provider, and styles.
directories.ownership: Client implementation tasks own this subtree unless the plan declares a narrower owner.

directories.purpose: Platform-neutral contracts, schemas, locale resources, constants, and pure logic shared by server and client.
directories.ownership: Assign one task as owner for every shared artifact; parallel server and client tasks must not both write this subtree.

entries.purpose: Vite document shell; loads src/client/main.tsx.
inspectWhen: client entry or HTML changes

entries.purpose: Application scripts, dependencies, and runtime commands.
inspectWhen: a task changes dependencies or package scripts

entries.purpose: Vite plugins, development port, and API proxy.
inspectWhen: a task changes client build or dev-server behavior

entries.purpose: Aggregate TypeScript compiler options and complete application source check.
inspectWhen: a task changes the complete type-check or shared compiler options

entries.purpose: Client-only TypeScript check for src/client/ and platform-neutral src/shared/ files.
inspectWhen: a client task needs independent type-checking or client source inclusion changes

entries.purpose: Server-only TypeScript check for src/server/ and platform-neutral src/shared/ files.
inspectWhen: a server task needs independent type-checking or server source inclusion changes

entries.purpose: Initializes selected server resources, assembles the Hono app, starts HTTP, and closes resources.
inspectWhen: server startup, module bootstrap, or shutdown changes

entries.purpose: Owns global middleware, API errors, public/protected route wiring, and production SPA fallback.
inspectWhen: middleware, error shape, route order, or static hosting changes

entries.purpose: Public and authenticated business route registration points.
inspectWhen: server endpoints or route ownership changes

entries.purpose: Initializes resources for selected platform modules.
inspectWhen: a selected module changes server resource startup

entries.purpose: Server identity resolver and authentication boundary binding point.
inspectWhen: authentication, identity resolution, or authorization scope changes

entries.purpose: Default no-op server request locale boundary; replaced by the selected i18n module.
inspectWhen: server-side locale behavior or i18n wiring changes

entries.purpose: Database migration files governed by the approved design.
inspectWhen: a task adds or changes schema or migration registration

entries.purpose: SQLite migrations installed by the selected platform modules.
inspectWhen: a task adds or changes SQLite schema

entries.purpose: Mounts React and application-wide client providers.
inspectWhen: client mount or global provider changes

entries.purpose: Composes the top-level client application and navigation.
inspectWhen: top-level application composition or navigation changes

entries.purpose: Single browser request boundary, wire response normalization, and API error decoding.
inspectWhen: client API integration, wire conversion, or API error behavior changes

entries.purpose: Default client locale provider; replaced by the selected i18n module when installed.
inspectWhen: client translation behavior or i18n wiring changes

entries.purpose: Client application styles added by the selected UI integration.
inspectWhen: the task changes global styles or a selected UI integration

entries.purpose: Starts an isolated real HTTP server for application tests.
inspectWhen: a task adds server or HTTP integration tests

entries.purpose: Checks baseline HTTP errors, health, and production static fallback.
inspectWhen: a task changes platform entry behavior

entries.purpose: Creates isolated per-run QA databases and ready-to-login test identities.
inspectWhen: a task needs repeatable test accounts or business data

entries.purpose: Documents the per-app company, role, permission, and business-data fixture contract.
inspectWhen: a task adds or changes QA seed data

entries.purpose: Verifies selected dbkit startup, migrations, and database behavior.
inspectWhen: a task changes the dbkit binding or database startup

entries.purpose: Tailwind content scanning and theme configuration for the selected UI integration.
inspectWhen: a task changes Tailwind theme or content scanning

entries.purpose: PostCSS plugins for the selected Tailwind UI integration.
inspectWhen: a task changes CSS processing

requiredApplicationBindings: Record business-specific state changes through auditKit.record
Review retention and access policy for audit history
